title: GPT-4 API general availability and deprecation of older models in the Completions API
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: GPT-3.5 Turbo, DALL·E and Whisper APIs are also generally available, and we are releasing a deprecation plan for older models of the Completions API, which will retire at the begin...
body:
GPT-3.5 Turbo, DALL·E and Whisper APIs are also generally available, and we are releasing a deprecation plan for older models of the Completions API, which will retire at the beginning of 2024.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
